title: JsonRpcEnvelope
description: JSON-RPC 2.0 message envelope for CaseForge sidecar IPC over stdio (PRD §4.1). Product method names are NOT defined here.
$comment: PARTIAL — JSON-RPC 2.0 is the protocol named by the PRD. Method catalogues per sidecar are BLOCKED (Q-IPC-01).

method.description: Method name must match a frozen sidecar catalogue once Q-IPC-01 is resolved.

params.description: Positional array or named object per JSON-RPC 2.0. Exact shapes per method are BLOCKED.

normative_invariants: IPC is typed JSON-RPC over stdio.
Schemas for product methods live under /contracts/ipc/*.json and must be frozen before AC-4.1 can fully pass.

stable_error_codes.$comment: Product-stable error codes for vault/licence/IPC are batch B-S0-03 (errors.json). JSON-RPC reserved codes (-32700..-32600) apply at the protocol layer.
